name: @iaziz786/pi-merge-gateway-login
description: Pi extension that adds the Merge Dev gateway (docs.merge.dev/merge-gateway) as a model provider via its OpenAI Responses API, serving GLM 5.3 Flash and DeepSeek V4 Flash / V4.1 Flash under the gateway's own model ids, with the gateway choosing the host.
